WHAMMO.Title: TomWa Warhammer HUD
WHAMMO.Failed: That did not work. See the console (F12).
WHAMMO.Drag: Drag the HUD from anywhere to move it. Double-click: back above the hotbar.

Settings.ShowAdvantageHint: A large counter at the front of the HUD: Advantage in WFRP (Momentum with the 5th edition rules), the party's Superiority in Imperium Maledictum, Glory in Wrath & Glory and Soulfire in Soulbound. The GM changes it: click adds one, right-click removes one. Players only see it.
Settings.OnlyEquippedHint: Put-away ranged weapons move to the small gear group.
Settings.ShowGearHint: A small group of icons for equipping melee weapons and shields with one click. Left out while Hands are shown.
Settings.LowAmmoHint: The count turns amber at this number or below.
Settings.ShowHandsHint: Systems with hand rules (WFRP, Imperium Maledictum): what each hand holds, with two-handed weapons taking both. Click a hand to pick a weapon for it, right-click to empty it.
Settings.ShowActionsHint: Tabs above the hotbar with the character's tests, weapons, spells and conditions.
Settings.ActionsOnlyEquippedHint: Player characters show only equipped weapons and armour. NPCs and creatures always show everything.
Settings.BlindOnShiftHint: Holding Shift while clicking a test in the panel makes it a Blind GM roll.
Settings.SkipDialogByDefaultName: Skip the roll dialog by default
Settings.SkipDialogByDefaultHint: Tests from the panel roll straight away; hold Alt to see the dialog. When off, Alt skips it.
Settings.ShowUnrollableTraitsHint: Also list traits that have no test (clicking posts them to chat).
Settings.ShowTokenTestsHint: Quick tests with their values on the token's HUD, for anyone who owns the character.

WHAMMO.SuperiorityReadOnly: The party's Superiority (only the GM changes it).
WHAMMO.GloryReadOnly: The party's Glory (spent in tests; only the GM changes it by hand).
WHAMMO.SoulfireReadOnly: The party's Soulfire (only the GM changes it by hand).

Hands.Label: Hands
Hands.Hint: Click: choose what this hand holds. Right-click: empty it.
Hands.Useless: This hand cannot hold anything (an injury or effect).
Hands.OffhandHintWfrp: Attacks with this hand take the off-hand penalty (the system applies it). With Dual Wielder you can attack with both weapons.
Hands.OffhandHintIm: This is not the character's dominant hand; the system applies the off-hand rules to its tests.
Hands.NoHands: The character does not have enough hands for this weapon.

WHAMMO.MomentumHint: Momentum (5th edition rules): +1 Advantage on Weapon Skill tests. Gained by winning a melee opposed test in combat or by charging; lost on taking damage, losing a melee opposed test, gaining a condition, or when combat ends. The system tracks this itself. Click: give or take Momentum. Right-click: take it away.
WHAMMO.AdvantageReadOnly: The character's Advantage (only the GM changes it by hand).
WHAMMO.MomentumReadOnly: Momentum (5th edition rules): +1 Advantage on Weapon Skill tests. Gained by winning a melee opposed test in combat or by charging; lost on taking damage, losing a melee opposed test, gaining a condition, or when combat ends. Only the GM changes it by hand.

WHFRAMES.Title: TomWa Warhammer HUD
WHFRAMES.Hint: Click: target. Double-click: go to the token. Right-click: open the sheet.
WHFRAMES.NoToken: {name} has no token on this scene.

Settings.ShowFramesHint: For this user only. Off by default: turn them on here or with the party frames button in the token controls.
Settings.PlayersSeeAllHint: When off, players see only the health bars of characters they do not own, without numbers, resources or conditions.

WHFRAMES.Toggle: Show or hide the party frames
WHFRAMES.HiddenInfo: Party frames hidden. Bring them back with the party frames button in the token controls.

Choose.Title: Characters in the party frames
Choose.Hint: Ticked characters are shown in the frames for the current mode. Only you see this choice.

Notify.ItemMissing: This item no longer exists on the actor.
Notify.EffectMissing: This effect script is no longer available.
Notify.ActionFailed: The action failed. See the console (F12) for details.
Notify.NotEnoughAdvantage: Not enough Advantage: costs {cost}, you have {current}.
Notify.NoCareer: This character has no current career.

WFRP4E_HUD.CareerCheckText: Checks whether the current career level is complete and what moving up or changing career costs. Only you see the answer in chat.

Career.MissingAdvancements: {missing} more advancement(s) needed to complete this level.
Career.Incomplete: This career level is not complete yet.
Career.NextLevel: {ok} Next level of this career: {cost} XP (only once the level is complete).
Career.LastLevel: This is the last level of the career path.
Career.Change: Change career: {okSame} {same} XP in the same class, {okOther} {other} XP in another class.
